scientific.integrity: The infinite statement is proved arithmetically; exact enumeration is used only for the finite residual cases and as a regression check.
scientific.limitations: Restricted to canonical weighted projective spaces with weight vector \(1^r,a,b\); no claim is made for arbitrary weighted or fake weighted projective spaces.

title: Anticanonical volume separates canonical \(\mathbb P(1^r,a,b)\) above dimension three
